requirements.title: Accepted Alpha.7.4 baseline remains immutable
requirements.exactGap: No data-plane code gap. Beta.1 requires static guards so later packages cannot silently change accepted evidence, production compatibility, schemas or user-pipeline state.
requirements.minimalDelta: Add read-only bootstrap metadata and regression guards only.
requirements.acceptanceTest: Full Alpha regression passes; accepted release pins and evidence metadata remain exact; no physical-write API is present in Beta.1.0.

requirements.title: Paired DWH TECH and Publish backup
requirements.exactGap: No registered paired-backup operation, BACKUP_REGISTRY, shared backup_id, pair manifest, PARTIAL resume contract or freshness status exists in the accepted source inventory.
requirements.minimalDelta: Inventory any reusable copy helpers, then add one Operation Engine handler and one registry/manifest contract without creating a second executor.
requirements.acceptanceTest: SUCCESS creates one registered DWH+Publish pair; PARTIAL retries only the missing member; isolated restore rehearsal reproduces the pair.

requirements.title: Rollback any eligible load_id
existingComponents: Gate 6 and Gate 7 exact reversal evidence
requirements.exactGap: The reversal engine is accepted, but there is no general eligibility API, read-only impact preview, mandatory user reason/confirmation contract or compact terminal evidence for an arbitrary selected load_id.
requirements.minimalDelta: Add a thin eligibility/preview/submit facade over RAW_REVERSAL_V4 and existing dependency processing.
requirements.acceptanceTest: An eligible load_id completes preview → reason → reversal → Publish/aggregate/latest update → quick audit; repeated submit is idempotent.

requirements.title: Uncovered operational failure matrix
existingComponents: Operation Engine retry and lease tests
Gate 4–Gate 7 lost-response, timeout and recovery proofs
requirements.exactGap: Existing tests cover many data-plane failures, but not the complete Beta operational surface such as paired-backup PARTIAL, general rollback interruption, stale intake trigger and materialized-status recovery.
requirements.minimalDelta: Extend existing DEV-only test handlers and failure flags only for uncovered boundaries.
requirements.acceptanceTest: Each injected failure proves no duplicate write, no false SUCCESS and continuation from the exact durable checkpoint.

requirements.title: Trigger, stale-operation and recovery hardening
requirements.exactGap: Accepted components do not yet provide one consolidated trigger-ownership registry, stale-operation/watchdog classification and normalized next_action for all future user-facing operations.
requirements.minimalDelta: Consolidate guards around the existing Operation Engine; do not add a second queue or executor.
requirements.acceptanceTest: Exactly one trigger owner exists per process; stale and retryable states are classified; incompatible writes cannot run concurrently; safe stop and resume preserve checkpoints.

requirements.title: Compact health, freshness, issue and backup status
requirements.exactGap: Source registries exist, but DATASET_STATUS, ISSUE_REGISTRY and BACKUP_REGISTRY are not materialized as a compact read model with freshness, progress, checkpoint and next_action.
requirements.minimalDelta: Materialize and incrementally refresh compact status tables from existing registries; UI reads must not scan full RAW or Publish.
requirements.acceptanceTest: Status reads are bounded and show release, health, freshness, active phase, progress, checkpoint, trigger, backup, issue and next_action.

requirements.title: Resumable Full Audit and retention dry-run
requirements.exactGap: Checks exist separately, but there is no unified resumable Full Audit operation, durable audit evidence, retention registry or protected-artifact dry-run.
requirements.minimalDelta: Orchestrate accepted checks through the existing Operation Engine and add retention planning in dry-run mode only.
requirements.acceptanceTest: Audit resumes after interruption and produces evidence; retention dry-run protects accepted releases, Gate evidence, baseline and required backups; no physical deletion occurs.
